name.fr-FR: Le Prédicateur de l’amour de Dieu
name.en-US: The Preacher of the Love of God
name.pt-BR: O pregador do amor de Deus

description.fr-FR: Ouvrage posthume attribué au P. Jean-Joseph Surin, S.J. (1600-1665) : les Questions sur l’amour de Dieu, en deux livres de questions et réponses sur le pur amour (chacune suivie d’un « coup d’œil sur les dispositions de son cœur », affections de l’éditeur), puis un mois de degrés pour s’élever à un grand amour de Dieu, des avis salutaires et trente entretiens du chrétien en oraison avec Jésus-Christ, extraits des autres écrits de Surin et mêlés de pages de François de Sales et de Jean de la Croix. Le style a été retouché par l’éditeur. Nouvelle édition de 1824, qui rétablit le chapitre supprimé par la censure impériale.
description.en-US: A posthumous work attributed to Fr. Jean-Joseph Surin, S.J. (1600-1665): the Questions on the Love of God, two books of questions and answers on pure love (each followed by a “glance at the dispositions of one’s heart”, affections added by the editor), then a month of steps to rise to great love of God, salutary counsels and thirty colloquies of the Christian at prayer with Jesus Christ, drawn from Surin’s other writings and mixed with pages of Francis de Sales and John of the Cross. The editor retouched the style. The new edition of 1824, which restores the chapter suppressed by the imperial censors.
description.pt-BR: Obra póstuma atribuída ao P. Jean-Joseph Surin, S.J. (1600-1665): as Questões sobre o amor de Deus, em dois livros de perguntas e respostas sobre o puro amor (cada uma seguida de um « olhar sobre as disposições do coração », afetos acrescentados pelo editor), depois um mês de degraus para subir a um grande amor de Deus, avisos salutares e trinta colóquios do cristão em oração com Jesus Cristo, tirados dos outros escritos de Surin e entremeados de páginas de Francisco de Sales e de João da Cruz. O editor retocou o estilo. Edição nova de 1824.

fr-FR.editor: Anonymous editor (Paris: Méquignon junior / Lyon: Périsse frères, “nouvelle édition”)

sources.edition: Le Prédicateur de l’amour de Dieu, ouvrage posthume du Père Surin, à la suite duquel on trouve ce que recommandent sainte Thérèse, saint Jean de la Croix et saint François de Sales; nouvelle édition, Paris: Méquignon junior / Lyon: Périsse frères, 1824. Internet Archive scan, OCR text.
sources.description: The Grand motif and the address To those who wish to love God, the two books of Questions and answers (10 and 13 chapters, each with its Coup-d’œil), Book III (31 days), the Avis salutaires et sentiments affectueux (three groups) and the thirty Entretiens of the Chrétien en oraison. The table of contents and the printer’s matter are left out. Running heads stripped; chapter titles tidied by hand; the dropped initials of some chapters restored. Entretiens XXI and XXVI lost their headings in the OCR and their starts are inferred from the usual length of an entretien (a few lines may be misplaced); OCR slips remain (about 2% of words).
sources.tierEvidence: Surin died in 1665; the 1824 Paris edition is public domain everywhere.
